## POST `/api/2.58/pods`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Creates a pod on the local array. Each pod must be given a unique name across the arrays to which they are stretched. A pod cannot be stretched to an array that already contains a pod with the same name. After a pod has been created, add volumes and protection groups, and then stretch the pod to another connected array or realm.

## DELETE `/api/2.58/pods/arrays`

**Tier:** T3  

Deletes a pod that was stretchd to an array, collapsing the pod to a single array. Unstretch a pod from an array when the volumes within the stretched pod no longer need to be synchronously replicated between the two arrays.
